# shc_balance (Data Source)

Fetches the current account balance and available credit.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `balances` (Attributes List) Account balance entries by currency. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--balances))

<a id="nestedatt--balances"></a>
### Nested Schema for `balances`

Read-Only:

- `available_credit` (String) Available credit in the given currency.
- `currency` (String) Currency code (e.g., USD).
